race.comment: OCEAN GODDESS (1) returned from a spell last start with a strong win by 1.75 lengths over 1300m at Northam. Fitter for that last hitout and draws to continue the good form. RIGHT TO SILENCE (8) hit the frame two starts ago at this track but ran below par last time when 10th and beaten 8 lengths over 1300m at this track. Austin Galati gets the best out of this six-year-old mare and he goes back aboard, so worth another chance. AMARLIE MISS (10) didn't do a lot in a recent trial, but that was only over 950m. Got out to 1675m last prep, is a first-up winner and draws well, but perhaps the best push is Pike hopping back aboard. VAMPI QUEEN (5) scored her maiden win here last time out over today's trip, getting the decision by a long neck. That followed a good fresh run, so while this is a step up, we don't know her ceiling yet. CHOUX SHOE (2) turned in a decent effort last start to finish third over 1400m at this track. Best figures measure up. Sure to run well.
